description:
🏔️ ABOUT SIERRA STUDIO

Sierra Studio is an innovative product development firm dedicated to empowering founders and business leaders in their quest to create impactful, meaningful products. Our team of experienced professionals is committed to delivering high-quality solutions that drive business growth. We prioritize a culture of good vibes, open communication, and continuous learning, providing our team members with the opportunities and resources they need to thrive.

This role is with one of the teams we help build through our staffing partnerships. When you apply, Sierra manages the hiring process, but you'll be hired directly by and work within the client company.

🏢 ABOUT THE COMPANY

Our hiring partner is a collective of seasoned operational experts and passionate problem solvers with broad, diverse skill sets, earned knowledge, and a nimble, systems-first approach. They empower innovators to navigate complex operational challenges with proven, sustainable solutions, and they thrive on helping founders and leaders avoid the acute pains they endured while scaling their own fast-growing companies.

Their service is flexible and ranges from ad hoc advisory to end-to-end supply chain management and optimization. The team guides businesses of any size or stage through launch, rapid growth, and the inevitable operational hurdles that follow.

Identifying, analyzing, and solving the "impossible" is daunting to most, but exhilarating to them - which is why they built the company. Their mission is to transform the world's wildest visions into tangible realities.

Our hiring partner manages client work via well defined procedures across Google Workspace and various point solutions. As the company grows, embraces AI, and evolves to better meet client needs, they need someone to own the development of a single platform the team and their clients can rely on.

🖼️ ABOUT THE ROLE

This is the company's first engineering leadership hire, a permanent, full-time role reporting to the VP of Operations. You'll build out the engineering department, own the full technology stack, and take over development and maintenance of backend systems from the current lean team – you'll own how things are built, secured, and run in production.

This is a hands-on role. You'll write much of the code yourself at first, and as the platform grows, identify requirements, hire, and lead a small team of engineers.

🔨 WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Systems discovery with leadership and the operations team, mapping what exists and what needs to be built.

  • Own the technology stack and be the point person called when something breaks across infrastructure.

  • Run the IT environment (Google Workspace, Slack, Airtable, and other software): permissions, onboarding and offboarding, access reviews, MFA, password management, devices, backups, and recovery.

  • Set the security standards for handling sensitive client supply chain data, especially as tools scale and become external-facing.

  • Put engineering fundamentals in place: version control, code review, testing, deployment, monitoring, and access control.

  • Take over code written by non-engineers and AI coding tools and bring it up to production standard.

  • Replace existing low-code interfaces with an in-house front end and back end, without disrupting daily work.

  • Build internal AI tools, including agents, tool integrations, retrieval, and evaluation.

  • Lead development of client portals and the next version of the company's operations hub, working directly with clients on scoping and delivery.

  • Train and coach the operations team on the new tools you ship.

  • Own the technical roadmap and document decisions so non-engineers can follow them.

  • Hire, onboard, and manage your first engineers.

  • Own the software and hosting budget.

🤝 WHO YOU ARE

  • A builder with a bias for action. You'd rather ship something coherent, get feedback, and iterate than debate for weeks.

  • Technically deep enough to make the calls the team can't: how to handle security, what to build in, and whether another engineer's code is actually good.

  • You're proud of what you can do and genuinely curious about what the operators around you already know.

  • Patient and service-minded. You enjoy teaching and coaching people who aren't engineers.

  • Comfortable changing direction when a new client brings a new need.

  • Polished on calls, since you'll occasionally join conversations with client founders.

  • Optimistic, with a "yes, and" approach.

  • Honest about where your expertise ends, and quick to bring in help when it does.

🔎 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required:

  • Strong full-stack production engineer: TypeScript, React, Postgres and relational databases, testing, deployment, and monitoring.

  • Experience with cloud hosting, ideally GCP (Cloud Run, Hosting) and Cloudflare (Workers, D1).

  • Solid knowledge of security, hosting, IT best practices, and data management, with the judgment to own decisions across the whole stack.

  • Has built something from the ground up and been instrumental in its scale.

  • Has owned the maintenance and improvement of a system other teams relied on.

  • Genuinely wants to build a team.

  • Fluent written and spoken English. Most decisions happen in Slack and in documents.

Preferred:

  • Management experience, ideally leading a small engineering team.

  • Production AI systems: agent orchestration, tool use, MCP or equivalent, retrieval, and evaluation.

  • Cybersecurity experience.

  • Background in supply chain, CPG, e-commerce, or consulting.

🧭 HIRING PROCESS

  • Screening interview with Sierra.

  • Technical interview with Sierra.

  • Culture interview with the company.

  • Role interview focused on the day-to-day.

  • Executive interview.

📍 LOCATION

Remote, based in Brazil, full-time. The team meets in person at least once a year, and all team members are flown in for offsites.

💰 COMPENSATION

100,000 –130,000 USD/year + equity, plus PTO and other benefits, which may vary by region.
